newsitem.title: USA: Mirage Resorts expected to issue debt.
newsitem.headline: Mirage Resorts expected to issue debt.

text.p: Mirage Resorts Inc is expected to tap the corporate bond market with a $250 million two-part debt offering, dealers said on Thursday.
The deal is expected to include $150 million of a 10-year tranche and $100 milllion of a 20-year issue, dealers said.
Unofficial price talk on the 10-year issue is seen at 85 basis points over Treasuries and 100 basis points over on the 20-year, dealers said.
Credit Suisse First Boston is expected to underwrite the offering, they said.
Mirage Resorts owns two Las Vegas casino hotels, a casino in Laughlin, Nev., and property in the Atlantic City marina area.
